Join us! We're looking for a Software Test Engineer Co-op to join our Vancouver office for a full-year internship opportunity. This is a hands- on role where you'll work side-by-side with experienced test engineers and developers on cutting-edge network security software technology. While you'll be working locally out of our Vancouver office, the team you'll collaborate with is spread throughout North America- primarily based out of our Seattle HQ. You'll be immersed in a real-world engineering team, gain exposure to our development processes, and have the chance to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product. What You'll Be Doing • Following detailed test cases and executing hands-on testing in real environments. • Writing simple testing tools and scripts to support the team. • Collaborating with test engineers, developers, support staff, and technical writers. • Testing client-server applications over a variety of network environments. • Advocating product quality by elevating issues when necessary and verifying fixes. • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers Other duties as assigned by management • Why This Co-op Rocks • Real-world, hands-on QA experience on a strategic product. • Mentorship from seasoned engineers. • A chance to build your technical skillset while working with a geographically diverse team. Exposure to Agile workflows, client-server architecture, and modern development practices. • This is an opportunity to challenge yourself, grow professionally, and make meaningful contributions-all while surrounded by supportive teammates who want to see you succeed. Job Requirements What You Bring to the Team • You're working toward a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field-or you've completed relevant coursework or previous testing experience. • You have a basic understanding of networking concepts and protocols. • You're comfortable working in Windows-based network environments with Mac, Android, and iOS clients. • You've dabbled in scripting (Python preferred) and are curious about programming (C# or Java is a bonus). • You're excited to learn new concepts, especially around testing and networking fundamentals. • You're self-driven and can manage your tasks independently but also thrive when working as part of a collaborative team. • You have strong analytical thinking and solid organizational skills. Bonus: You speak a second language (Japanese, French, Italian, German, Spanish = extra points!). • Citizenship Requirement N/A Position Start Date Position End Date June 08, 2026 12:00 AM June 04, 2027 12:00 AM APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through UBC Science Co-op Cover Letter Required?
